title: Everyday chat · Phase 2
description: Per-chat drafts, temporary chats, attachments and long-chat recovery for native Lumen.
notes: Drafts follow each conversation. Temporary chats stay in memory and out of synced history.
Attach photos and supported files. Chat deletion preserves cloud originals that another conversation may need. Full account deletion removes those originals.
Open older pages in long chats, continue interrupted replies and sync independent chats with automatic retries.
Oversized turns keep their drafts, earlier unavailable attachments do not block replies, and refreshed history preserves pages and system instructions.
